title: shrink-ci-bootstrap-toolchain-lease-and-remove-legacy-node-symlinks
author: Arielle Ng
release_notes: Reduce CI bootstrap latency (~35%) by introducing a short-lived toolchain lease and trimming legacy node symlink handling. No runtime API changes. Self-hosted runners require a one-time cleanup (script included).
description: Context: Our presubmit/setup time spikes when many CI jobs concurrently download large devtool artifacts (node toolchains, vendored binaries). This causes build queues, intermittent timeouts, and occassional checksum mismatches for flaky downloads. Motivation: Move from best-effort per-job downloads to a coordinated, lease-driven bootstrap that bounds concurrent toolchain fetches and removes historical node symlink indirections that were added during a past migration. Summary: This PR implements a lightweight toolchain lease manager that serializes artifact downloads across concurrent runners, introduces a short-term local cache warmup step, and removes legacy node symlink resolution logic that added complexity to devcontainer and CI bootstrap code. The description below is a concise narrative, commit list, changed areas, testing notes and review thread captured as a single continuous string. Commits: - feat(ci): add toolchain lease manager and short-term cache TTL - refactor(bootstrap): simplify node detection and remove legacy symlink fallbacks - chore(scripts): add self-hosted runner cleanup script and migration note - fix(ci): increase presubmit timeout for windows images while warming cache - docs(ci): document lease behavior and troubleshooting notes Changed areas (high-level): .github/workflows/presubmit.yml: add lease acquisition step and move heavy downloads to warm-cache job ci/lease/manager.go: new coordinator used by presubmit and nightly to get lease token tools/toolchain/bootstrap.go: implement lease-aware download + backoff logic scripts/cleanup/remove-old-node-symlinks.sh: idempotent helper for self-hosted runners ci/cache/README.md: notes on TTLs and cache sizing Dockerfile.ci: use simplified PATH layout devcontainer.json: remove legacy symlink hooks docs/dev/ci.md: updated presubmit expectations and migration steps Why this approach: central lease avoids thundering-herd downloads without requiring a remote cache provider upgrade. Lease TTL is short (default 90s) and falls back to direct download if acquisition fails after a small backoff window, so no hard outages. Migration / rollout plan: - Stage 1 (opt-in): new lease manager enabled in presubmit lanes for non-blocking warm-cache job (2/20–2/24) - Stage 2 (enforce): enable for all presubmits and add self-hosted cleanup in onboarding (2/25–2/28) - Stage 3 (clean): remove legacy symlink code paths and mark final in docs (merged 3/02) Testing performed: unit tests for lease logic + deterministic backoff (ci/lease/*), local integration using 8 parallel ephemeral runners to validate queueing and no checksum regressions, smoke presubmit runs on linux/windows/mac images, manual self-hosted runner cleanup verification on a baremetal agent. Observability: added metrics (lease_acquire_latency, lease_acquire_failures, cache_warm_success) and logs include lease token id for tracing. Rollback plan: flip a feature flag in presubmit job to skip lease acquisition and restore direct downloads if we see >5% presubmit failure rate in a 1-hour window. Known limitations: does not replace a full artifact proxy; peak throughput still bounded by network but variance reduced. Review thread summary: - Marcus: requested stronger telemetry and explicit unit test for jitter algorithm (addressed in commit 2) - Leah: asked to reduce lease TTL to 60s; we settled on 90s after testing under 50 concurrent jobs - Omar: suggested a clearer migration note for on-prem runners; added cleanup script and docs - CI: initial e2e flake on windows artifacts (flaky-download) was traced to a transient CDN edge issue; reran and green. Merge: squashed and merged after approvals. Related: ENG-2027 (presubmit perf), ENG-2041 (self-hosted infra hygiene). Checklist: [x] unit tests added [x] integration smoke runs [x] docs updated [x] migration helper included Links: Linear ENG-2027, ENG-2041; Deploy notes in docs/dev/ci.md; Slack thread #infra-ci for post-merge observations.

notes_for_oncall: If presubmit failures spike after merge, flip CI_PRESUBMIT_USE_LEASE=false in repo secrets and open an incident. Watch lease_acquire_failures metric and presubmit queue length.
